head: fc3e34c5f6115b55751874df21c3a9286bd09a5e
claim: The single permitted final full smoke cannot pass against the currently staged candidate. Its acceptance criterion requires at least one genuine collision carrying non-empty sorted unique contact_ids and a finite non-negative relative_speed. The staged player emits collision events with an empty payload, so validate_physics_shot_artifact rejects every shot that contains a collision.

verification_performed_this_wave.why: the defect was recalled from prior work, so it was re-verified against current on-disk state rather than trusted

recorded_defect.finding: staged player emits collision events with an empty payload
recorded_defect.consequence: validate_physics_shot_artifact rejects every shot containing a collision (invalid_event at the collision event: payload fields differ from taxonomy)
recorded_defect.why_prior_instrumentation_passed: the accepted smoke shot contains no collision event, so this path was never exercised by the acceptance evidence

consequence_for_this_gate.outcome_if_smoke_were_run: guaranteed rejection at artifact validation, whether or not the listener binding succeeds
consequence_for_this_gate.decision: the full smoke was NOT run. Running it would consume the one permitted execution to re-confirm a defect already established by evidence, and would leave no run available after a fix.
consequence_for_this_gate.fix_location: player-side C# capture payload, not this gate's Python tooling
consequence_for_this_gate.fix_requires: rebuild -> republish -> re-smoke, which is a full re-pin

collateral_confirmation.physics_port: the player serves the request-70 socket on the agent port 2004
collateral_confirmation.flag_status: --physics-port appears not to reach the player: a probe run that passed a random free port (57699) through the flag never saw a listener on that port, while a run using the 2004 default bound one immediately. The flag is recorded as unproven and the port is driven explicitly.
collateral_confirmation.prior_planner_defect: the planner emitted agent_port+1 (2005), where no listener ever appears
